headline: Slifer the Sky Dragon
title: Slifer the Sky Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Slifer the Sky Dragon. What is it? It is one of the three Egyptian God Cards, a Level ten DIVINE Divine-Beast. What does it do? It gains one thousand attack and defense for each card in your hand, and when your opponent summons a monster in Attack Position, that monster loses two thousand attack, and is destroyed if that drops it to zero. How do you use it? It needs three Tributes to Normal Summon, and if it is Special Summoned it goes back to the Graveyard in the End Phase. Keep a big hand to make it strong.
